description: Implementation of the SchemeHostPortMatcher class for matching URL schemes, hosts, and ports with rules, including methods for adding, replacing, evaluating, and serializing rules.

classes.name: SchemeHostPortMatcher
classes.description: Class for matching URL schemes, hosts, and ports based on a list of rules, with methods for rule management and evaluation.

methods.name: FromRawString
methods.description: Creates a SchemeHostPortMatcher object from a raw string containing rules separated by delimiters.

methods.name: AddAsFirstRule
methods.description: Adds a rule to the beginning of the rule list.

methods.name: AddAsLastRule
methods.description: Adds a rule to the end of the rule list.

methods.name: ReplaceRule
methods.description: Replaces a rule at a specified index.

methods.name: Includes
methods.description: Checks if a URL is included based on the evaluation of rules.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the URL against the list of rules to determine match result.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Serializes the rule list into a string.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all rules from the matcher.
